title: Fix Tutorial Text Legibility
summary: Round 1: raised the shared type scale (body 2.5%->3.2%, label 2.2%->2.7% of frame height); wrote check_layout.py, a dry-run collision checker. Round 2: trimmed SUBTITLE/CAPTION back down slightly per feedback; widened the checker to catch raw VMobject curves (its real blind spot) and fixed two bugs that surfaced doing so; fixed the real collisions found in Heating scene_1 and Cooling scene_6 (both 0 hard findings). Round 3 ('do the same for heating videos'): extended the same checker pass to scene_2/3/4/5 (conduction, convection, internal gains, solar gain) -- confirmed they already inherited the bigger fonts via shared constants -- and fixed 13 more real collisions, plus one missing apply_scene_style() bug in final_calculation/merged_scenes.py. That last file is pre-shared-template legacy (ad hoc font sizes throughout, no Beat* classes) and was flagged as a separate migration rather than silently rewritten. All checked files: 0 hard findings.
